title: Composition and iteration of functions
terms: composition; composite function; iteration; functional recurrence; identity function.

exposition.text:
For compatible functions, (g ◦ f)(x) = g(f(x)): apply the rightmost function first. The exact
domain is {x ∈ dom f : f(x) ∈ dom g}. Composition is associative but usually not commutative.
The identity map id (x) = x is neutral for composition on A.
